blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) on Tuesday said it is investigating an alleged data breach involving the Philippine Air Force (PAF) following online claims that sensitive military personnel and administrative records had been compromised. AFP spokesperson Col. Francel Margareth Padilla said military cybersecurity units were examining the allegations but had yet to establish whether or not any information had been compromised. “At this point, these are mere speculations,” Padilla said in a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City. She said the AFP monitors thousands of attempted cyberattacks daily and maintains safeguards to protect its systems. […]... Keep on reading: AFP probing into alleged Air Force data breach
